subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts

question: Should the Control UI intentionally stop persisting Nostr relay imports immediately and require users to press Save & Publish after reviewing the imported draft?
rationale: The implementation fixes the cancellation and stale-response race, but it also changes a shipped workflow from import-and-persist to import-review-save; code correctness cannot decide whether that persistence behavior is an accepted product change.

options.title: Approve draft-first imports
options.body: Accept the safer review-before-write workflow while preserving explicit `autoMerge: true` for non-Control-UI callers.

options.title: Preserve import persistence
options.body: Require the PR to retain automatic persistence and solve cancellation through a different server-side transaction or commit protocol.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Keep the existing behavior until maintainers define the intended import and cancellation contract more broadly.

recommendation.title: Approve draft-first imports
recommendation.body: Accept the safer review-before-write workflow while preserving explicit `autoMerge: true` for non-Control-UI callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest combined involvement in the original Nostr surface and its subsequent profile-route maintenance.
